sections.heading: One platform for continuous quality
sections.body:
testoriumz is Linkfields’ own quality engineering platform. It brings test management, low-code automation, root-cause analysis and dashboards together to support continuous testing.

Built for web, mobile, API and enterprise systems such as SAP, the platform connects testing with CI/CD delivery. Explore our [quality engineering services](/services/digital-transformation/quality-engineering) for the testing approach and support around it.

cards.title: Low-code testing
cards.description: Create and manage automated tests with low-code tools, making reusable testing part of everyday software delivery.

cards.title: AI root-cause analysis
cards.description: Use AI-led analysis and failure-pattern dashboards to investigate test failures and focus attention on quality issues.

cards.title: CI/CD integration
cards.description: Embed automated test execution into CI/CD and DevOps pipelines to check software as it changes.

sections.heading: Continuous testing, built into delivery
sections.description: Start with an assessment and a focused proof of concept. Build reusable tests, then connect execution and reporting to your delivery pipeline.
